senses.en: to surround or cover something, especially with smoke or mist

ex.en: After the lecture, we used wreathe in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了环绕。

ex.en: Students who can explain wreathe usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 能解释环绕的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。

col: be wreathed in smoke｜被烟雾笼罩
mist wreathes the hills｜薄雾环绕山丘
a face wreathed in smiles｜满面笑容
tip: 偏文学用语；wreathe尾音/ð/，wreath尾音/θ/。

senses.en: A spinning mass of fluid drawing things towards its centre
A situation that pulls people into increasing confusion or difficulty

ex.en: Office hours began with a swirling vortex.
ex.zh: 答疑从盘旋的涡流开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a swirling vortex.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论盘旋的涡流的材料。

col: a vortex of debt｜债务旋涡
be sucked into a vortex｜被卷入旋涡
tip: 复数可用vortices或vortexes；也可比喻困境。

senses.en: to prevent something or make it impossible

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to preclude the possibility.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须排除可能性。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to preclude the possibility.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们排除可能性。

col: preclude someone from doing something｜使某人无法做某事
preclude further discussion｜使进一步讨论无法进行
tip: 正式用词；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

senses.en: To make someone annoyed, worried, or frustrated.

ex.en: The assignment is to vex policymakers, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先困扰政策制定者，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers vex policymakers before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要困扰政策制定者。

col: be vexed by delays｜因延误而烦恼
tip: 较正式的及物动词，日常多用annoy。

senses.en: A small detail or distinction requiring careful understanding
A small convention of polite social behaviour

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize nicety in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出微妙细节。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses nicety when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了微妙细节。

col: legal niceties｜法律上的细微区别
tip: 多用复数 niceties，勿直接理解为“美好”。

senses.en: to distort something good or proper for harmful purposes

ex.en: The assignment is to pervert the course of justice, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先妨碍司法公正，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to pervert the course of justice and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你妨碍司法公正，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: pervert the course of justice｜妨碍司法公正
tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前且常含贬义。

senses.en: The theft of small amounts or items, especially from workplaces.

ex.en: Our professor circled prevent pilferage on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了防止小额偷窃。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prevent pilferage.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕防止小额偷窃展开说明。

col: losses from pilferage｜小额失窃造成的损失
tip: pilferage是不可数名词，不是动词；动词为pilfer。

senses.en: showing strength and energy traditionally associated with men

ex.en: Our professor circled virile image on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了阳刚形象。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around virile image.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕阳刚形象展开说明。

col: virile young man｜强健的年轻男子
tip: 不只是“男性的”；强调传统观念中的男性力量与活力。

senses.en: a long, detailed piece of writing about a particular subject

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a philosophical treatise.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论哲学论著。

ex.en: The author returns to a philosophical treatise when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了哲学论著。

tip: 常用a treatise on，指系统详尽的专论而非短文。

senses.en: Form an opinion using limited evidence
An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to surmise that.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须推测……。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to surmise that.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得推测……。

tip: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

senses.en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions

ex.en: Our professor circled terminable contract on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可终止的合同。

ex.en: The reading connects terminable contract with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可终止的合同和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: terminable on notice｜通知后可终止的
terminable by either party｜任何一方均可终止的
tip: 正式法律用语，常形容合同；不等于terminal。

senses.en: say what will happen, especially through claimed spiritual knowledge

ex.en: The lab instructions say to prophesy that.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求预言……。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to prophesy that.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来预言……。

tip: prophesy是动词，词尾读/saɪ/；名词为prophecy。

senses.en: An indirect suggestion or indication of something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the first intimation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最初的暗示。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the first intimation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕最初的暗示展开说明。

col: an intimation of trouble｜麻烦的征兆
tip: 别与intimacy（亲密）混淆；常接of或that从句。

senses.en: An excessive display of wealth or importance to impress others.

ex.en: Office hours began with an air of ostentation.
ex.zh: 答疑从炫耀的气派开始。

ex.en: The reading connects an air of ostentation with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把炫耀的气派和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an air of ostentation｜炫耀的气派
tip: 不可数名词，通常含贬义，强调故意展示以引人注目。

senses.en: The narrow lower part of the uterus opening into the vagina.

ex.en: The professor explained cervix with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了子宫颈。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up cervix while discussing evidence about public health.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了子宫颈。

col: the cervix of the uterus｜子宫颈
cells of the cervix｜子宫颈细胞
cancer of the cervix｜子宫颈癌
tip: 通常指子宫颈；cervical 也可表示颈部的。

senses.en: Someone who murders an important person, often for political reasons.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a would-be assassinator.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于企图行刺者的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a would-be assassinator to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用企图行刺者来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

col: the assassinator's motives｜暗杀者的动机
tip: 此词罕见；通常用assassin表示暗杀者。

senses.en: A unit of dry volume used especially for grain.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a bushel of wheat.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一蒲式耳小麦的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bushel of wheat.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一蒲式耳小麦的材料。

col: a bushel of wheat｜一蒲式耳小麦
tip: 是干量单位；英美容量不同，不能直接等同固定重量。

senses.en: lying flat with your face towards the ground

senses.zh: 精疲力竭的；悲痛难支的
senses.en: overwhelmed by exhaustion, illness, or strong emotion
to make someone lie face down or become extremely weak

ex.en: I copied prostrate with exhaustion into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把疲惫得无法动弹抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to prostrate with exhaustion when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了疲惫得无法动弹。

col: prostrate with exhaustion｜疲惫得无法动弹
tip: 勿与prostate（前列腺）混淆；注意多一个r。

senses.en: Showing the distinctive qualities of a person or thing.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on characteristical features.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论典型特征。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around characteristical features.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕典型特征展开说明。

tip: 罕见旧式形式；现代写作应优先用characteristic。
note: 罕见旧式形容词，现代英语通常用 characteristic。

senses.en: extreme poverty, with too little money for basic needs

ex.en: Office hours began with die in penury.
ex.zh: 答疑从在贫困中去世开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss die in penury.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论在贫困中去世的材料。

col: live in penury｜生活在赤贫中
die in penury｜在贫困中去世
reduce someone to penury｜使某人陷入赤贫
tip: 正式或文学用词，程度重于poverty，通常不可数。

senses.en: To grow or develop rapidly.

ex.en: The professor explained burgeon with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了迅速增长。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up burgeon while discussing evidence about economic policy.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了迅速增长。

col: a burgeoning industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
a burgeoning population｜迅速增长的人口
tip: 现代常作不及物动词；burgeoning常用于名词前。

senses.en: opposing social progress and wanting older political arrangements restored
someone who opposes progress and favours restoring older political arrangements

ex.en: Our professor circled reactionary policies on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了反动政策。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around reactionary policies.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕反动政策展开说明。

tip: 常含贬义，强调恢复旧制度；不等于reactive。

senses.en: to make someone extremely angry or frustrated

ex.en: The assignment is to madden someone, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使某人极为恼怒，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to madden someone.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们使某人极为恼怒。

col: be maddened by delays｜因延误而抓狂
tip: 通常是及物动词，表示使某人恼怒到抓狂。

senses.en: someone who writes or edits dictionaries

ex.en: Our professor circled a bilingual lexicographer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了双语词典编纂者。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a bilingual lexicographer.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得双语词典编纂者这个例子。

col: work as a lexicographer｜担任词典编纂者
a team of lexicographers｜词典编纂团队
a bilingual lexicographer｜双语词典编纂者
tip: 指编写或修订词典的人，不泛指语言学家。

senses.en: Rude and disrespectful, especially towards someone in authority.

ex.en: I copied insolent behaviour into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把傲慢无礼的行为抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects insolent behaviour with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把傲慢无礼的行为和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 现代常用作形容词；对应名词是insolence。

senses.en: To make an official decision about a dispute
To judge performances or entries in a competition

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to adjudicate a dispute.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何裁决纠纷。

ex.en: The passage says students who can adjudicate a dispute follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够裁决纠纷的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: adjudicate on a claim｜就索赔作出裁决
adjudicate a competition｜担任比赛评委
tip: 可直接接争议，也可用adjudicate on；不专指宣判刑罚。

senses.en: To shout or laugh at someone in an unkind way.
An unkind shout or remark intended to ridicule someone.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to jeer at someone.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须嘲笑某人。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to jeer at someone.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得嘲笑某人。

col: jeers from the crowd｜人群中的嘲笑声
a chorus of jeers｜一片嘲笑声
tip: 动词常用 jeer at someone；名词常用复数。

senses.en: Unwilling or reluctant to do something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces loth to admit in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了不愿承认。

ex.en: The reading connects loth to admit with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把不愿承认和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: loath的较少见变体；常用be loth to do。

senses.en: harmful or poisonous to people or other living things

ex.en: I copied noxious fumes into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有毒烟气抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to noxious fumes when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有毒烟气。

tip: 常形容气体或物质；不只是气味难闻。

senses.en: A system or machine sending document copies over telephone lines.
To send a document using a fax machine.

ex.en: The textbook introduces telefax machine in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了传真机。

ex.en: The author returns to telefax machine when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了传真机。

col: send by telefax｜通过传真发送
tip: 较旧的说法；现代英语通常直接用fax。

senses.en: generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival or weaker person

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on magnanimous in victory.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论胜而有雅量。

ex.en: A campus survey used magnanimous in victory to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用胜而有雅量来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a magnanimous gesture｜宽宏大量的举动
tip: 较正式，常形容对对手或冒犯者宽容大度。

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or moral boundary

ex.en: The lab instructions say to transgress the law.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求违法。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers transgress the law before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要违法。

col: transgress moral boundaries｜逾越道德界限
transgress social norms｜违反社会规范
tip: 正式用词，可直接接law、rules等宾语。

senses.en: To divide or spread into branches or connected parts.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to ramify into branches.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求分成枝杈。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers ramify into branches before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要分成枝杈。

tip: 正式且少见，常指根系、血管或网络分叉延伸。

senses.en: a system where employees reserve shared workspaces instead of permanent desks

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about office hotelling.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于办公位预约共享制的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss office hotelling.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论办公位预约共享制的材料。

col: office hotelling｜办公位预约共享制
hotelling system｜工位预约共享系统
tip: 通常指预约共享工位；旅馆业用hotel industry。
note: 真实词，亦拼作hoteling；现代常见义为办公位预约共享制，并非通常所说的旅馆业。

senses.en: Until now or until the time being discussed.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to hitherto unknown.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习此前未知的。

ex.en: Students who hitherto unknown are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够此前未知的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 正式用语，常见于hitherto unknown等搭配。

senses.en: Mentioned or presented earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the foregoing discussion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了上述讨论。

ex.en: A campus survey used the foregoing discussion to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用上述讨论来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 正式书面语，常用the foregoing修饰名词。

senses.en: to pay out money, especially from an official fund

ex.en: The professor asked us to disburse funds.
ex.zh: 教授让我们拨付资金。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers disburse funds before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要拨付资金。

tip: 正式用词，常以funds或money作宾语。

senses.en: A strong public reaction of anger or excitement.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used furor in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了公愤。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses furor when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了公愤。

col: cause a furor｜引起轩然大波
a furor over something｜因某事引发的风波
tip: 美式常用furor，英式常用furore；多指公众强烈反应。

senses.en: to pay all or part of a cost

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to defray costs.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何支付成本。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers defray costs before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要支付成本。

tip: 正式用词，宾语通常是costs或expenses，不是人。

senses.en: To excite desire for something that remains out of reach.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to tantalize someone with.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须用某物引逗某人。

ex.en: The reading asks you to tantalize someone with and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你用某物引逗某人，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: tantalize someone with｜用某物引逗某人
tantalizing glimpse｜勾起渴望的短暂一瞥
tantalizing prospect｜诱人却未实现的前景
tip: 英式也写tantalise；强调勾起欲望却暂时得不到。

senses.en: express a financial amount in a particular currency
give a particular name to something

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize denominate in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出以某货币计价。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up denominate while discussing evidence about economic policy.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了以某货币计价。

tip: 金融中常用be denominated in＋货币；命名义较罕见。

senses.en: Able to be hammered or pressed into a different shape.
Easily influenced or changed by other people or circumstances.

ex.en: Our professor circled highly malleable on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可塑性很强的。

ex.en: The reading connects highly malleable with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可塑性很强的和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 金属义强调锻压成形；ductile强调可拉成丝。

senses.en: The degree to which something can be sold easily.

ex.en: Office hours began with improve salability.
ex.zh: 答疑从提高适销性开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around improve salability.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕提高适销性展开说明。

tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写作saleability。

senses.en: News reporting, especially detailed accounts based on direct observation

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about investigative reportage.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于调查报道的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to investigative reportage when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了调查报道。

tip: 通常不可数，比reporting正式，常强调现场记录。

senses.en: Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original

ex.en: I copied sound trite into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把听起来很老套抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects sound trite with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把听起来很老套和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 强调因反复使用而失去新意，不只是年代久远。

senses.en: The everyday language spoken by people in a particular place.

senses.zh: 本地语言的；本土风格的
senses.en: Using local everyday language or traditional local building styles.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the local vernacular in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了当地日常用语。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the local vernacular.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得当地日常用语这个例子。

col: the local vernacular｜当地日常用语
tip: 强调当地日常语言，不等同于“本国的”。

senses.en: To make someone feel excited, energetic, and very happy

ex.en: I wrote exhilarate on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把exhilarate和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain exhilarate usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释使兴奋的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

col: exhilarated by the experience｜因这次经历而振奋
an exhilarating experience｜令人兴奋的经历
tip: 及物动词；人感到兴奋用exhilarated。

senses.en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure
a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number

ex.en: The textbook introduces infinitesimal amount in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了极微小的量。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of infinitesimal amount.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得极微小的量这个例子。

tip: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

senses.en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole

ex.en: Office hours began with componential analysis.
ex.zh: 答疑从成分分析开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of componential analysis.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得成分分析这个例子。

tip: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

senses.en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement

ex.en: The textbook introduces the aforesaid conditions in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了上述条件。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the aforesaid conditions.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论上述条件的材料。

tip: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

senses.en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language.
To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.

ex.en: Office hours began with profane language.
ex.zh: 答疑从粗俗的语言开始。

ex.en: The reading connects profane language with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把粗俗的语言和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

senses.en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle

ex.en: I copied a fractured tibia into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把骨折的胫骨抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a fractured tibia.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论骨折的胫骨的材料。

col: the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨
tip: 即shinbone；复数可用tibias或tibiae。

senses.en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about vehement opposition.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于强烈反对的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of vehement opposition.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得强烈反对这个例子。

tip: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。

senses.en: A gemstone often showing changing colours when light strikes it

ex.en: I copied precious opal into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把贵蛋白石抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of precious opal.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得贵蛋白石这个例子。

tip: 珠宝语境常称“欧泊”；并非所有蛋白石都有变彩。

senses.en: having many different kinds or aspects

ex.en: The textbook introduces multifarious activities in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多种多样的活动。

ex.en: The author returns to multifarious activities when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了多种多样的活动。

tip: 正式词，强调种类多；日常多用varied或diverse。

senses.en: A substance that drives something forward or forces liquid out
Providing the force that moves something forward

ex.en: I copied rocket propellent into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把火箭推进剂抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used rocket propellent to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用火箭推进剂来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 是propellant的较少见拼写；写作优先用后者。

senses.en: Unwilling to do something.

ex.en: I wrote loath on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把loath和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain loath usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释不情愿的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

col: be loath to admit｜不愿承认
be loath to leave｜不愿离开
be loath to accept｜不愿接受
tip: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

senses.en: Something believed to solve every problem or cure every illness.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on no panacea.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论并非万能之策。

ex.en: The author returns to no panacea when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了并非万能之策。

col: a panacea for｜解决……的万能之策
a universal panacea｜包治百病的灵丹妙药
tip: 常用a panacea for；多用于否定万能解法。

senses.en: Lose a pregnancy before the baby can survive outside the womb.
Fail to achieve the intended result.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to miscarry early in pregnancy.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何孕早期流产。

ex.en: The reading asks you to miscarry early in pregnancy and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你孕早期流产，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: miscarry early in pregnancy｜孕早期流产
tip: 通常指流产；表示计划失败时较正式且少见。

senses.en: A person or organisation that accepts insurance risks.
An institution guaranteeing to buy securities not purchased by investors.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on insurance underwriter.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论保险承保人。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss insurance underwriter.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论保险承保人的材料。

tip: 保险领域指承保人，证券领域指承销商。

senses.en: Transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer transship cargo during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时转运货物。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to transship cargo.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来转运货物。

tip: 过去式为transshipped，现在分词双写p。

senses.en: a tree mainly native to Australia, with strongly scented leaves

ex.en: The textbook introduces eucalyptus tree in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了桉树。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around eucalyptus tree.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕桉树展开说明。

tip: 指树种；eucalyptus oil指从桉树叶提取的精油。

senses.en: Honest and trusting, often through a lack of worldly experience.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an ingenuous smile.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论天真无邪的微笑。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an ingenuous smile.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得天真无邪的微笑这个例子。

col: an ingenuous smile｜天真无邪的微笑
an ingenuous question｜天真坦率的提问
tip: 勿与ingenious（巧妙的）混淆；本词强调天真坦率。

senses.en: Something earlier that influenced or resembled a later thing.
A word or phrase that a later pronoun refers to.
Existing or happening before something else.

ex.en: I copied a pronoun's antecedent into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把代词的先行词抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a pronoun's antecedent.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得代词的先行词这个例子。

col: historical antecedents｜历史先例；历史根源
a pronoun's antecedent｜代词的先行词
tip: 语法中指代词所指的先行词；不宜直接等同祖先。

senses.en: living mainly in trees
relating to trees

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on arboreal species.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论树栖物种。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss arboreal species.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论树栖物种的材料。

tip: 常用于动物学，描述主要生活在树上的动物。

senses.en: To compensate for loss or provide financial protection against it.

ex.en: The assignment is to indemnify someone against loss, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先保障某人免受损失，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to indemnify someone against loss.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保障某人免受损失。

col: indemnify someone against loss｜保障某人免受损失
indemnify someone for damage｜赔偿某人的损害
tip: 法律正式用语：for接已受损害，against接防范风险。

senses.en: A set of criteria used to assess work.
Instructions explaining how to complete a task or examination.
A heading or category under which something is grouped.

ex.en: I copied an assessment rubric into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把评估细则抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an assessment rubric.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕评估细则展开说明。

col: under the rubric of｜归入……类别
tip: 教育中常指评分细则，也可指试题作答说明。

senses.en: The state of being married, especially in formal or religious language.

ex.en: I copied joined in matrimony into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把结为夫妻抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to joined in matrimony when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了结为夫妻。

col: the bonds of matrimony｜婚姻的纽带
tip: 正式或宗教用语；日常谈婚姻通常用marriage。

senses.en: extremely careful to do things correctly and thoroughly
careful to act honestly and avoid doing anything wrong

ex.en: Office hours began with scrupulous attention to detail.
ex.zh: 答疑从对细节的一丝不苟开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scrupulous attention to detail.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕对细节的一丝不苟展开说明。

col: scrupulous attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟
tip: 既可指做事严谨，也可指恪守道德。

senses.en: a large branch of a tree

ex.en: The textbook introduces a low bough in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了低垂的大树枝。

ex.en: The reading connects a low bough with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把低垂的大树枝和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a low bough｜低垂的大树枝
a spreading bough｜向外伸展的大树枝
tip: 读音与cow押韵；通常指大枝，小枝用twig。

senses.en: A compound containing sulphur combined with another element or group

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about iron sulphide.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于硫化铁的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of iron sulphide.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得硫化铁这个例子。

tip: 美式及国际化学命名常写sulfide；勿混同硫酸盐。

senses.en: examine something closely to understand it fully
measure how deep water is
a weight on a string used to check vertical alignment

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to plumb the depths of.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何深入探究；达到低谷。

ex.en: The passage says students who can plumb the depths of follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够深入探究；达到低谷的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: plumb the depths of｜深入探究；达到低谷
tip: 词尾 b 不发音；plumb the depths 常用于比喻。

senses.en: Peaceful in nature or intended to avoid conflict

ex.en: Office hours began with pacific approach.
ex.zh: 答疑从和平的处理方式开始。

ex.en: The author returns to pacific approach when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了和平的处理方式。

tip: 小写pacific是正式形容词；the Pacific指太平洋。

senses.en: Move or rise and fall in a smooth, wave-like pattern.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer undulate gently during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时轻轻起伏。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers undulate gently before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要轻轻起伏。

tip: 描述地形起伏时，常用形容词undulating。

senses.en: the general opinion people have of someone or something
to consider someone or something to have a particular quality

ex.en: I wrote repute on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把repute和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up repute while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了名声。

col: of international repute｜享有国际声誉的
tip: 动词多用被动式be reputed to be，意为“据说是”。

senses.en: Following the styles that are currently fashionable.

ex.en: I copied modish clothes into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把时髦的服装抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of modish clothes.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得时髦的服装这个例子。

tip: 较书面，有时暗含“追逐潮流”的意味。

senses.en: Using power cruelly and unfairly to control others.

ex.en: Our professor circled a tyrannical ruler on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了暴虐的统治者。

ex.en: A campus survey used a tyrannical ruler to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用暴虐的统治者来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: a tyrannical ruler｜暴虐的统治者
tip: 不仅指政治暴政，也可形容老板等人的专横行为。

senses.en: Unwilling to help others or adjust to their needs.

ex.en: Office hours began with an unaccommodating attitude.
ex.zh: 答疑从不肯通融的态度开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used an unaccommodating attitude to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用不肯通融的态度来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: an unaccommodating attitude｜不肯通融的态度
an unaccommodating employer｜不肯通融的雇主
tip: 指不愿帮助或迁就他人，不表示没有住宿。

senses.en: In this document, statement, or situation.

ex.en: The lab manual says to herein lies the problem before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先问题就在于此，再记下数字。

ex.en: Students who herein lies the problem are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够问题就在于此的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

col: herein lies the problem｜问题就在于此
tip: 正式或法律用语，常指“在本文件中”。

senses.en: Causing strong dislike or a feeling of sickness.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on disgustful smell.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论令人作呕的气味。

ex.en: The author returns to disgustful smell when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了令人作呕的气味。

tip: 此词罕见且偏旧；现代英语通常用disgusting。
note: 真实但罕见、偏旧的词；通常用disgusting

senses.en: to provoke someone into acting through persistent pressure or annoyance
a pointed stick used to make animals move
something that strongly pushes a person to act

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to goad someone into doing something.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何激某人做某事。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to goad someone into doing something.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来激某人做某事。

col: goad someone into doing something｜激某人做某事
goad someone on｜不断刺激某人行动
a goad to action｜行动的驱动力
tip: 常用goad sb into doing，通常含负面刺激。

senses.en: the Western world, especially Europe and North America

ex.en: The textbook introduces the Occident in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了西方世界。

ex.en: The reading connects the Occident with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把西方世界和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the Orient and the Occident｜东方与西方
tip: 旧式用语，通常写作the Occident；现代多用the West。

senses.en: in accordance with a law, rule, or agreement

ex.en: Office hours began with pursuant to regulations.
ex.zh: 答疑从依照法规开始。

ex.en: The reading connects pursuant to regulations with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把依照法规和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: pursuant to an agreement｜根据协议
tip: 几乎总用于pursuant to，常见于法律等正式文本。

senses.en: To swell or become larger because of pressure from inside.

ex.en: I wrote distend on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把distend和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on public health uses distend when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了胀大。

col: distended with gas｜因气体而膨胀
tip: 多用于医学，强调内部压力导致胀大。

senses.en: Numerous and varied
A pipe system distributing or collecting gas or liquid

ex.en: I copied exhaust manifold into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把排气歧管抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around exhaust manifold.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕排气歧管展开说明。

tip: 形容词用法较正式，常修饰benefits、problems等复数名词。

senses.zh: 兴趣广泛的；兼收并蓄的
senses.en: Including or appreciating a wide variety of things.
Relating to the Christian church led by the Pope.
A member of the Christian church led by the Pope.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a practising Catholic in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了践行信仰的天主教徒。

ex.en: The reading connects a practising Catholic with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把践行信仰的天主教徒和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a practising Catholic｜践行信仰的天主教徒
tip: 小写指广泛包容；指天主教或其信徒须大写Catholic。

senses.en: to understand something in the wrong way

ex.en: I heard the lecturer misconceive someone's intentions during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时误解某人的意图。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to misconceive someone's intentions.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得误解某人的意图。

col: misconceive someone's intentions｜误解某人的意图
tip: 较正式；日常表达“误解”更常用misunderstand。

senses.en: To kill someone or something, especially violently.

ex.en: The assignment is to slay a dragon, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先杀死恶龙，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers slay a dragon before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要杀死恶龙。

tip: 过去式slew，过去分词slain；常见于文学或新闻。

senses.en: Someone favouring individual freedom and minimal government control
Favouring individual freedom and minimal government control

ex.en: I copied libertarian views into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把自由意志主义观点抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects libertarian views with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自由意志主义观点和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: libertarian views｜自由意志主义观点
libertarian principles｜自由意志主义原则
a libertarian approach｜自由意志主义的做法
tip: 强调个人自由和有限政府，不等同于liberal。

senses.en: infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to such infection

ex.en: The textbook introduces a septic wound in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了感染的伤口。

ex.en: The author returns to a septic wound when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了感染的伤口。

tip: septic tank 指化粪池；septic 不作“腐烂物”名词。

senses.en: Payment or a reward for work, loss, or inconvenience.
To pay or reward someone for work, loss, or inconvenience.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fair recompense.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公平的报酬。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fair recompense.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕公平的报酬展开说明。

col: recompense someone for something｜因某事补偿某人
tip: 较正式；动词用recompense sb for sth。

senses.en: an unusual habit or feature particular to someone or something

ex.en: The professor explained idiosyncrasy with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了特性。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses idiosyncrasy when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了特性。

col: linguistic idiosyncrasies｜语言上的独特之处
tip: 可数名词，复数为idiosyncrasies，常指独特习惯。

senses.en: Showing great enthusiasm and commitment to a cause or activity.

ex.en: The textbook introduces overly zealous in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过分热心的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around overly zealous.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕过分热心的展开说明。

col: a zealous supporter｜热忱的支持者
zealous in their efforts｜努力而热忱
tip: 语气比enthusiastic强，有时暗示热心得过头。

senses.en: The process of correcting an error or putting something right
The process of converting alternating electric current into direct current

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about half-wave rectification.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于半波整流的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to half-wave rectification when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了半波整流。

tip: 正式名词；日常说“纠正”常用correction。

senses.en: with that thing or together with it
immediately after that

ex.en: The professor explained therewith with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了随同。

ex.en: Students who can explain therewith usually follow the rest of a lecture on public institutions.
ex.zh: 能解释随同的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共制度的讲座。

col: documents submitted therewith｜随同提交的文件
costs associated therewith｜与此相关的费用
tip: 古旧或法律用语；日常用with it或along with it。

senses.en: A wooden frame joining two animals to pull a load.
A condition of being controlled or oppressed.
Join animals with a frame, or force things together.

ex.en: Our professor circled a wooden yoke on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了木轭。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a wooden yoke.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得木轭这个例子。

col: the yoke of oppression｜压迫的枷锁
tip: 与 yolk（蛋黄）同音；比喻义常指压迫的枷锁。

senses.en: To firmly reject a claim, belief, or association.
To refuse to honour an agreement or pay a debt.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer repudiate an allegation during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时坚决否认指控。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to repudiate an allegation.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们坚决否认指控。

col: repudiate an allegation｜坚决否认指控
repudiate a claim｜驳斥某种说法
repudiate a contract｜拒绝履行合同
tip: 是正式动词，不是名词；名词为repudiation。

senses.en: An event happening by chance, or chance itself.

ex.en: I copied an element of fortuity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把偶然因素抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used an element of fortuity to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用偶然因素来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: an element of fortuity｜偶然因素
tip: 较罕见的正式词；日常表达多用chance或coincidence。

senses.en: serious disagreement or conflict between people or groups

ex.en: Office hours began with social strife.
ex.zh: 答疑从社会冲突开始。

ex.en: The author returns to social strife when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会冲突。

tip: 不可数名词，语气正式，比一般争论更严重。

senses.en: A brief fight between small groups of opposing forces.
A brief argument, often within a larger disagreement.
Fight or argue briefly without a major confrontation.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on border skirmish.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论边境小规模冲突。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of border skirmish.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得边境小规模冲突这个例子。

col: skirmish over something｜围绕某事的争执
tip: 强调规模小、时间短；也可比喻口头争执。
